rationale: The request directly concerns workflow-level accessibility obstruction in an approval process and asks for a no-change replacement motion, selecting Redesign. The response inspected the only fixture evidence, made no writes, proposed a coherent end-to-end accessible approval workflow, preserved constraints and unrelated behavior, supplied a proportionate verification plan, and clearly carried unavailable implementation details as open decisions. It did not claim implementation or affected-user validation. The visible “Redesign mode” label was unnecessary under the contract because the user requested a replacement motion but did not explicitly say “Redesign mode”; however, the substantive Redesign boundary was respected.
